snippet.title: Shopping Cart Hero Flash Game
snippet.description:
A Man, A shopping cart... A dream.  Shopping Cart Hero, a classic flash game is about a guy who upgrades and flies his shopping cart.  Truly an inspiring hero, maybe one day he'll have a golden cart.  Anyway, it's your classic launcher flash game where you earn points for going further and higher.  Then unlocking new upgrades to keep on breaking records.
